verdict.rationale: An authenticator app holds account and sign-in data, so it could plausibly offer AI-generated security insights or suggestions, which means the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only passwordless sign-in, OTP codes, backup, password export, Verified IDs and App Lock. None of it mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
